method: Independent known-region checks. Countries are audit controls, never mineralization polygons. Production is used only as a contradiction check; geological resources and historical sources determine evidence type. A positive record somewhere in a country cannot pass a province-wide completeness test.

resources.regions: Mojave; Anatolian borate basins; Andean salars; Jarandol/Jadar
resources.problem: Borax/kernite, colemanite/ulexite and borate brines must remain separate. Sparse mines do not describe volcanic-lacustrine basin potential.
resources.needed: Borate-bearing stratigraphic units and saline basin types; unworked deposits retained.

resources.regions: North African/Middle Eastern sedimentary phosphorite belts; igneous apatite provinces
resources.problem: Large specialist inventory helps, but an apatite/carbonatite point cannot generate sedimentary phosphorite. Offshore resources are a separate accessibility class.
resources.needed: Marine phosphorite formations versus igneous apatite hosts, depth and exposure.

resources.regions: Atacama nitrate fields; historically worked Appalachian/Kentucky cave sediments
resources.problem: Generic nitrate geography omits biological/cave and historical processing sources. Sodium and calcium nitrate evidence is not proof of naturally occurring potassium nitrate blocks.
resources.needed: Nitrate-bearing desert units, cave sediment evidence and recipe distinctions; avoid nitrogen fertilizer production maps.

resources.regions: Williston/Saskatchewan; Zechstein; Pripyat; Solikamsk; Khorat; Dead Sea
resources.problem: Permissive tracts are available but include brines and deeply buried strata. Modern mine closure does not remove potash geology.
resources.needed: Separate solid sylvite/carnallite/polyhalite from brines, preserve kilometre-scale depths and nonproducing resources.

resources.regions: European evaporite basins and historical salt districts; continental salt basins
resources.problem: Existing potash supplement is not a global halite inventory. Sea-salt works and salt lakes are not underground halite evidence. Sparse known kernels cannot justify exclusion elsewhere.
resources.needed: Mapped halite-bearing formations and buried evaporites, separately from brine and marine salt production.

resources.regions: Carpathian Foredeep native sulfur; sedimentary and volcanic systems
resources.problem: Composite sulfur layer is dominated by pyrite/sulfide feed. It cannot locate native sulfur; refinery recovery is another distinct source.
resources.needed: Native sulfur-bearing carbonate/evaporite units and volcanic fumaroles; retain historical native sulfur deposits after production declines.

resources.regions: East African/Madagascan metamorphic belts; Sri Lankan veins; Norwegian graphite-bearing units
resources.problem: Mine-only or US-weighted points miss graphite-bearing metamorphic units and undeveloped resources. Flake, vein and amorphous graphite differ.
resources.needed: Carbonaceous metamorphic formations, graphite form, inferred resources and depth.

resources.regions: Global fluorite vein and replacement districts, including closed/reopening European districts
resources.problem: Elemental fluorine in phosphate cannot automatically become fluorite. Existing record density badly overweights US coverage.
resources.needed: Fluorite-specific vein, carbonate-replacement and intrusive provinces; historical districts and small occurrences.

resources.regions: Quartz-bearing granites, veins, pegmatites, sandstones and metamorphic rocks worldwide
resources.problem: Ore-field/silica-mine points are fundamentally the wrong availability model for ordinary quartz. Gangue quartz and common rock-forming quartz were excluded; electronic-grade quartz has a much narrower distribution.
resources.needed: Ordinary quartz abundance/vein model from geology, separate from industrial purity and gem quality.

resources.regions: Primary kimberlite/lamproite provinces and transported alluvial/coastal diamonds
resources.problem: MRDS alone misses many recorded districts. Legacy DIADATA adds historical/nonmined occurrences but includes imprecise gazetteer positions and stops around 2004.
resources.needed: Primary host bodies versus source-linked placers, nonproducing occurrences and modern survey updates.

resources.regions: Ruby/sapphire metamorphic and basalt-related districts and placers
resources.problem: Only 14 MRDS country labels and 90% US records. Industrial corundum, ruby and sapphire cannot share an unconditional gem-quality rule.
resources.needed: Separate gem type, host and transported source; recent districts and legacy coordinate review.

resources.regions: Colombian sediment-hosted and schist/ultramafic-associated emerald districts
resources.problem: Fifteen baseline records cannot represent global emerald geology. GEMDATA is a useful locality complement, not formation coverage.
resources.needed: Specific beryllium-chromium/vanadium mineral systems and historical workings; ordinary beryl is not emerald.

resources.regions: Norwegian dunites and worldwide mafic/ultramafic olivine; peridot districts separately
resources.problem: Forty-five baseline records conflate industrial rock-forming olivine with peridot gemstones. Mine points understate widespread suitable lithology.
resources.needed: Ultramafic/dunite units for ordinary olivine, distinct gem-quality peridot occurrence layer.

resources.regions: Metamorphic schists/gneisses, contact systems and heavy-mineral placers
resources.problem: US-biased industrial records and sparse gem records do not describe common garnet-bearing rocks. Gem species/grade must remain separate.
resources.needed: Metamorphic mineral assemblages and placer provenance; per-species gemstone rules.

resources.regions: Badakhshan; Chilean Andes; Baikal and Pamir lazurite districts
resources.problem: Two baseline records from one country are a severe coverage failure. Host association is specialized; blue rock or generic limestone is insufficient.
resources.needed: Reviewed lazurite/lapis localities and contact/metamorphic carbonate systems; legacy positions need checking.

resources.regions: Historically exploited alum shale and alunite systems
resources.problem: Five-country, 93% US mineral-mention map omits historical shale feedstocks. Alunite, natural alum salts and manufactured alum are different resources.
resources.needed: Acid-sulfate alteration/alunite and suitable pyritic shale separately; historical processing supply must not generate natural alum crystals.

resources.regions: Granitic pegmatite/greisen and rhyolitic systems; secondary placers
resources.problem: Thirty-seven baseline records in five countries miss broad known gemstone districts. Colour and recoverable crystal quality are not identified by ordinary topaz occurrence.
resources.needed: Topaz-bearing intrusive/volcanic systems, weathered/placer pathways and historical locality review.

resources.regions: Pegmatite/metamorphic tourmaline districts worldwide
resources.problem: Ore-only 69-record baseline excludes widespread accessory/gangue tourmaline and many gem localities. Black schorl does not imply coloured elbaite gems.
resources.needed: Separate common tourmaline from gem species and pegmatite zoning; include subeconomic and historical occurrences.

resources.regions: Beryl-bearing pegmatite provinces
resources.problem: Industrial beryl/beryllium, aquamarine and other colours cannot be inferred from one another. Existing points do not describe pegmatite province potential.
resources.needed: Mineral-species and gem-variety evidence, pegmatite host/zoning and historical/subeconomic supply.

resources.regions: Gem spinel in metamorphic carbonate terrains and placers
resources.problem: Sixteen baseline records in five countries are far from global. Generic spinel-group minerals or ultramafic rocks do not establish gem spinel.
resources.needed: Verified gem spinel districts, host reactions and placer sources; legacy coordinates require review.
